title: He Calls His Own by Name

request.style: English, Celtic folk hymn, clear gentle tenor male vocal, uilleann pipes, Celtic harp, fiddle, bodhran, low whistle, tender and steady, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
At the gate of the sheepfold in the early light of day
The gatekeeper opens and the shepherd leads the way
He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out
And they follow where he goes, for they know his voice

[Chorus]
I am the good shepherd
The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep
I know my own and my own know me
And I lay down my life for the sheep

[Verse]
The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy
But the shepherd brings his flock to pasture and to joy
When the wolf comes down the hired hand will run
But the shepherd stands his ground for every single one

[Chorus]
I am the good shepherd
The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep
I know my own and my own know me
And I lay down my life for the sheep

[Bridge]
I am the gate. Whoever enters through me will be saved
I came that they may have life, and have it in abundance
I have other sheep that are not of this fold
There will be one flock, one shepherd

[Chorus]
I am the good shepherd
The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep
I know my own and my own know me
And I lay down my life for the sheep

[Outro]
They know his voice
One flock, one shepherd
